mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
